data.body: S2 plan-review v2: BLOCK down to blocking=1 (from 5). Remaining finding [T8] was fair — I named a rebar override table without defining its schema/keys/lookup/precedence/entries. Investigated before inventing one, and found it is LOAD-BEARING not speculative: anthropic_model_profile(claude-opus-4-8).supports_json_schema_output is TRUE (verified), so a naive profile read would flip rebar PRIMARY provider from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput — silently breaking the deliberate choice at structured.py:40-46 AND the existing assertion at test_structured.py:179. SECOND KEY FINDING: Bedrock-hosted Claude gets a BedrockModelProfile, NOT an AnthropicModelProfile (sibling ModelProfile subclasses), yet also reports supports_json_schema_output=True — so an isinstance(AnthropicModelProfile) override alone would MISS the exact models this epic exists to support and Bedrock Claude would wrongly get NativeOutput. Discriminator for Bedrock-hosted Claude is the profile FIELD bedrock_thinking_variant==anthropic (verified: anthropic for Bedrock Claude, openai for Bedrock OpenAI, absent/None for Meta/Amazon) — a capability-field read, materially different from the banned resolved.startswith(anthropic) model-string match. THIRD: I tried an elegant flag-only rule (supports_json_schema_output AND NOT supports_thinking) and TESTED it against every provider in todays _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS — it BREAKS TWO: gemini-2.5-flash has supports_thinking=True and groq has supports_json_schema_output=False, both of which would lose NativeOutput. Rejected it; documented why. Defined the table as an ORDERED (predicate, overrides) tuple (not a name-keyed dict, which would reintroduce string matching and cannot span two hosts of one model family), first-match-wins, overrides applied AFTER profile derivation, with exactly ONE entry (_is_claude covering both hosts). DISCLOSED ONE INTENTIONAL BEHAVIOR CHANGE: groq moves NativeOutput->PromptedOutput because its profile says supports_json_schema_output=False; accepted deliberately (profile is authoritative, groq unreachable via rebar _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX, untested, safe direction) and pinned by a test so it is deliberate not incidental. Re-reviewing.
